title: Listening Drill — Dune grass recovery
description: Short academic talk. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Dune grass recovery
sections.transcript:
PRESENTER: Today I'm describing a small study of grass growing on coastal dunes. I want you to listen for how the researchers measured change, because the result is easy to overstate.

PRESENTER: Their work took place on the landward side of a dune reserve. Instead of relying on what local people remembered, they recorded plant cover. They noticed faster recovery. That observation would have been missed if the team had visited only at the end.

PRESENTER: The largest limitation was wind exposure. The report is therefore a starting point. In a follow-up, the team would add exposed plots. A wider study could show whether the original pattern holds.
